verdict.rationale: Meltano is a CLI-first tool. Its CLI manages projects, plugins and pipelines, `meltano run` executes pipelines, and `meltano add` is documented as idempotent. It ships as a prepackaged Docker image, and the docs explicitly frame projects for CI/CD; a community user reports running it in production. missing for 10: a documented CI-runner example (e.g. a GitHub Actions or GitLab CI config), explicit documentation of non-interactive/headless flags, independent hands-on reports of CI usage specifically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Meltano provides a command line interface (CLI) that makes it easy to manage your project, plugins, and EL(T) pipelines.
You can run EL(T) pipelines using [`meltano run`]
benefit from DataOps best practices such as version control, code review, and continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD)
Meltano is pip-installable and comes in a prepackaged docker container
Meltano is open source, self-hosted, CLI-first, debuggable, and extensible.
